topic.angle: The jackpot compared with coin flips

card.title: Your chance at the Powerball jackpot

body.question: With one ticket, the Powerball jackpot odds are 1 in about how many?
body.reveal: About 1 in 292 million. That is slightly less likely than flipping a fair coin 28 times and getting heads every time, which is about 1 in 268 million.

probes.question: About how many fair-coin flips in a row, all heads, are as unlikely as the jackpot?
Powerball jackpot odds are about 1 in ____ million.
